body:
web-capture pins npm `browser-commander` to 0.10.0, the first release that forwards `executablePath` and `channel`. Issue #154 explicitly requests this version to avoid unrelated native dependencies introduced in later releases.

Registry evidence on 2026-10-07:

```sh
npm view browser-commander@0.10.0 dependencies --json
npm view browser-commander@latest version dependencies --json
```

0.10.0 depends only on log-lazy and test-anywhere. Current 0.26.2 adds better-sqlite3 13 and packages for native browser storage access. Adding that installation requirement to all capture consumers needs a packaging decision and validation across downstream VSIX/desktop consumers.

This is the explicit blocker for the dependency-freshness policy in #157. The fixes for #153 and #154 are complete with Puppeteer 25 and browser-commander 0.10.0; this tracker concerns adopting later native storage functionality. Keep this issue open while that pin is required. Remove the pin and its manifest blocker after either upstream makes native storage optional or packaged consumers are validated with it.
title: Track native storage dependency before upgrading npm browser-commander beyond 0.10.0
